sources.entry: dejalu - Fast and Simple Email Client.

summary.one_liner: dejalu is a fast, simple email client repository, with a README that is very short and mostly covers build dependencies and API keys.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes dejalu as a fast and simple email client and links to a download on the project website. It lists npm-installed build tools (uglify-js and clean-css-cli) as dependencies. It notes that full functionality needs several API keys: Google (Gmail accounts and Google Analytics), Microsoft (Outlook connectivity), HockeyApp (crash reports), and GIPHY (GIF support). It also gives basic build steps: clone the repo and initialize its git submodules. The README does not describe features, screenshots, or usage in detail.
use_cases: build an email client from source
explore a simple email client codebase
notable: Simple email client aimed at speed and ease of use
Integrates Gmail and Outlook accounts via Google and Microsoft API keys
Uses git submodules for its build
caveats: Several features need third-party API keys (Google, Microsoft, HockeyApp, GIPHY); parts of the app will not work without them
README is sparse and gives no setup or usage detail beyond build dependencies
Download is only pointed to a website, not a release in the repository
